what_would_add_a_real_writer: A complete human interpretation must say what a head denotes, what each modifier does, which combinations are legal, and what an initial headless singleton does. Those rules may be hypothetical, but must be explicit and shared across all uses.

Alternatively a fixed finite source-letter/syllable inventory could restrict permitted whole cells, or a physically specified mark-ownership law could have an independently observed consequence. Merely learning all observed cells as free entries would not test that restriction.

Any new content or physical rule must yield a possible counterexample beyond mere failure to run the canonical splitter. The rule should precede target comparison; no maximum run length, convenient vowel value, silent default, m classification or whole-word exception is inserted here.

A globally bijective word-to-word rendering still preserves the equality/frequency partition of a fixed source. Cell regrouping alone does not evade prior fixed-source word-frequency constraints. No new source-frequency or native count is made.
